# ParallelMultiCompartmentSNN

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neuron architecture with multiple parallel compartments, each processing different temporal scales of input, enabling multi-scale temporal feature extraction within a single neuron. Enables efficient temporal multi-scale processing in neuromorphic hardware, critical for handling complex real-world signals without deep network stacks.
